notes.title: Last update!
notes.notes:
Fleximan's Adventure Ends
Here, the Fleximan adventure comes to an end, or at least for now.

I'm working on a new "meme" project, or "una meme" for those who love the Grammy.

I've downgraded the graphics; after all, the "for the glory" option is honest. Let's say it doesn't look too bad. The police writing is legible, and that's the important thing.

I've added the Dragon Balls to mourn the passing of the dear San!

I've also added Japanese music that only starts when you collect the spheres (from the 4th onwards).

What can I say? Thank you for everything: the support, the feedback, and the affection.

I've even made a Fleximan book, if you want. Obviously, it's not real, but everyone is making books, so I thought it was fair to say this sentence too!

P.S. Finally, I've made the house that you all practically wrote to me about enterable, and I've only put the sphere in it. That little house didn't deserve any attention.
